_avail.description: 2-channel 100 volt power amplifier, 2 x 240 watts bridgeable into 1 x 480 watts with program and priority input per channel, 24V priority output, tone control, 230V AC - 24V DC
_avail.portsMissing: Not stated: speaker output connector type (terminals, set to terminal-block) and 24 V DC emergency input connector (set to other)

ports.label: Program In 1
ports.notes: Channel 1 balanced line 0 dB / 10 kOhm, Euroblock (+ - G); bridge mode uses channel 1

ports.label: Priority In 1
ports.notes: Channel 1 balanced line priority input on the priority control connector (Euroblock)

ports.label: Program In 2
ports.notes: Channel 2 balanced line 0 dB / 10 kOhm, Euroblock (+ - G); bridge mode uses channel 1

ports.label: Priority In 2
ports.notes: Channel 2 balanced line priority input on the priority control connector (Euroblock)

ports.label: Speaker Out 1
ports.notes: Terminals COM, 4 ohm, 35/50/70/100 V, 240 W; use one tap only; bridge across channels 1+2 for 480 W

ports.label: Speaker Out 2
ports.notes: Terminals COM, 4 ohm, 35/50/70/100 V, 240 W; use one tap only; bridge across channels 1+2 for 480 W

ports.label: Priority Contact 1
ports.notes: Shorting the contact activates priority input 1 and the 24 V priority output; on the priority control connector

ports.label: Priority Out 1
ports.notes: 24 V DC, 0.6 A max while priority is active, for attenuator priority relays; on the priority control connector (only channel 1 in bridge mode)

ports.label: Priority Contact 2
ports.notes: Shorting the contact activates priority input 2 and the 24 V priority output; on the priority control connector

ports.label: Priority Out 2
ports.notes: 24 V DC, 0.6 A max while priority is active, for attenuator priority relays; on the priority control connector

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: 230 V AC, standard IEC power cord; 8.0 AT fuse in the socket

ports.label: DC In 24V
ports.notes: 24 V DC emergency battery / supply input, 6.5 A per channel (13 A program); connector type not stated
